Surpressed Desire

Passive

Increases Evasion of all allies by 30%, and when an ally except for the caster evades, counterattacks. After attacking, when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes it all, granting Demon Blade Unleashed to the caster for 1 turn, before activating Blade Art: Bewitching Blossom. Blade Art: Bewitching Blossom: Consumes all Health to attack all enemies, and increase Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's lost Health.
